root_causes.title: vi.mock baked into modules cached by an earlier file
root_causes.mechanism: vitest replaces a module only for importers evaluated after vi.mock registers, and invalidates only the mock:<id> node (node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/index.Bi0NXYPf.js:176,188,324); with isolate:false the worker keeps every evaluated module (base.Cof-UHJf.js:215-220 invalidates only the test file). A cached module keeps an earlier file's mock factory (or the real module the current file mocks).
root_causes.shared_state: the worker's module registry; most often server/src/db/client.ts (mocked by 150 files with different factories)
root_causes.status: fixed by config (FP-1): no failure of this class in the final config (runs/w1-unit-s301, runs/w1-fresh3-s301)

root_causes.title: PUBLIC_TEST_AGENT_TOKEN captured at import by the training agent
root_causes.mechanism: src/training-agent/index.ts reads the token at import (:74) and builds module-level bearer authenticators (:212-218). 17 `unit` files set different tokens; the first importer's token wins in a shared worker (invalid_token).

root_causes.title: candidate-version env written in vi.hoisted and never restored
root_causes.mechanism: Files write ADCP_TRAINING_CANDIDATE_VERSION etc. directly in vi.hoisted; src/training-agent/candidate-version.ts derives exported consts from env at import (:13, :60, :64). Leaked env reaches the next file's fresh graph (tenant registry 503, VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, preview version mismatches).

root_causes.title: fixture-built module left in the registry
root_causes.mechanism: hosted-compliance-version.test.ts spies process.cwd() to a fixture tree, resets modules and imports the resolver, which reads published-versions.json at import; the fixture instance stays cached for later `unit` files.

root_causes.title: rate-limit flush timers outlive their file
root_causes.mechanism: Every CachedPostgresStore arms a 15 s unref'd setInterval in init() (src/middleware/pg-rate-limit-store.ts:177); src/middleware/rate-limit.ts builds 10 at import. Each fresh module graph adds 10 more. A store bound to a db/client mock without isDatabaseInitialized throws on every tick; the rejection escaped the timer and vitest counted it as an error of whichever file was running (71 and 218 errors in two single-worker unit-fresh runs; 0 in isolated runs).
root_causes.shared_state: server/src/middleware/pg-rate-limit-store.ts:177 (and :29-42 process-wide cleanup interval, already guarded by a globalThis flag)
root_causes.status: errors fixed (FP-5); residual: intervals still accumulate one set per fresh graph (memory/CPU only). Proper fix: CachedPostgresStore.shutdown() clearing flushTimer, called when the graph is discarded.

root_causes.title: tests that depend on the order inside their file
root_causes.mechanism: Fail alone with --sequence.shuffle.tests; independent of worker sharing.

root_causes.title: race inside a test, exposed by CPU load
root_causes.mechanism: exact-inference.test.ts resolves its child on the worker message while progress events travel on another port; under load the result can arrive first. Not a sharing leak: it also failed in an isolated run.
root_causes.status: allowlisted in unit-alone (fresh process, after the shared projects) until the test waits for both channels

root_causes.title: globals stubbed for the whole file
root_causes.mechanism: unstubGlobals restores vi.stubGlobal before every test, so a stub made in vi.hoisted/beforeAll/top level is gone when tests run (config-induced).

root_causes.title: WorkOS SDK base64 decoder chosen from built-ins an earlier file polyfilled
root_causes.mechanism: No mock survives the per-file reset. pdf-parse bundles core-js and installs Uint8Array.fromBase64/toBase64/toHex when imported. @workos-inc/node is loaded natively, once per worker, and picks its base64 decoder when it evaluates (lib/factory-*.mjs jsBase64Enabled): Uint8Array.fromBase64 if the API exists, atob otherwise. If a file that imports pdf-parse ran before the worker first loaded the real SDK, a malformed sealed bearer throws SyntaxError instead of DOMException InvalidCharacterError, which src/middleware/auth.ts did not classify, so the bearer branch answered 503. Node 25+ ships the API natively, so production would answer 503 too. Before the deferred-module change (37324b907c) native-auth-http-wiring loaded pdf-parse at import while its vi.mock kept the real SDK from loading first; now brand-book-import.test.ts is the polluter.
root_causes.shared_state: Uint8Array built-ins (process-global) as seen by @workos-inc/node at its evaluation in the worker
root_causes.status: fixed in src: auth.ts isInvalidSealedBearerError also accepts the TC39 decoder SyntaxError (adcp tp-jyw.55); regression test tests/unit/sealed-bearer-base64-decoder.test.ts; the VL-10-002 allowlist entry is no longer needed

root_causes.title: training-agent import cycle entered from a submodule
root_causes.mechanism: A unit-shared file that loads src/training-agent through state.ts instead of index.ts builds the cyclic graph in an order that leaves a binding undefined; the cached graph then breaks every later file in the worker that calls the agent. Isolated runs build the graph per file, so it never showed.
root_causes.shared_state: module registry of the unit-shared worker; cycle inside src/training-agent (module not identified)
root_causes.status: fixed in src: ACCOUNT_REF_SCHEMA and COMPLY_TEST_CONTROLLER_TOOL moved verbatim into import-free leaf modules (src/training-agent/account-ref-schema.ts, comply-test-controller-tool.ts), so no module reads them while their cycle is still evaluating; the FP-8 test-side workaround is reverted. root_causes.mechanism: process.env writes outside vi.stubEnv with no afterEach/afterAll restore. Not undone by unstubEnvs; the next file in the worker inherits them. Latent: no run in this investigation failed because of them.
